'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Siege of Gaza City]]
***Dozens of people are killed in an [[Israel]]i attack on the [[Al-Shifa Hospital]] in [[Gaza City]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] claims that twenty [[Hamas]] militants were killed, including a senior figure of the group. [https://nos.nl/collectie/13959/artikel/2513241-chaos-en-paniek-na-grote-israelische-aanval-op-al-shifa-ziekenhuis (NOS)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-68594153 (BBC News)]
***[[Al Jazeera Arabic]] reporter Ismail al-Ghoul is arrested by Israeli forces at Al-Shifa hospital, with the network joined by journalist advocacy groups in denouncing his arrest. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/18/al-jazeera-journalist-beaten-arrested-by-israeli-forces-from-gaza-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
**Afghanistan claims five women and three children are killed in two [[Pakistan]]i [[airstrike]]s in [[Afghanistan]], following accusations that attacks in Pakistan were masterminded in Afghanistan, which the [[Taliban]] authorities deny. In response, [[Afghan Army|Taliban forces]] open mortar fire on [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani troops]] at the [[Durand Line|border]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-carried-out-two-air-strikes-inside-afghanistan-killed-8-people-taliban-2024-03-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gang war in Haiti]]
**The bodies of at least twelve people are discovered in the neighborhood of [[Pétion-Ville]], in the [[Haiti]]an capital of [[Port-au-Prince]]. The perpetrators of the killings are unknown. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/18/at-least-12-bodies-found-after-new-gang-attacks-in-upscale-haiti-suburb (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**Around 80 people are kidnapped by unknown bandits near Kajuru Station, [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-68399883 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Schools across [[South Sudan]] close for the day, as an extreme [[heat wave]] is expected to hit the country. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/south-sudan-shutters-all-schools-as-it-prepares-for-an-extreme-heat-wave-13750030.html (Firstpost)]
